evals.prompt: Probe declared sameAs authority links on https://example.com to corroborate brand identity.
evals.expected_output: Authority link reachability status and claim corroboration evidence.
assertions: Broken 4xx/5xx sameAs links trigger BROKEN_AUTHORITY_ANCHOR findings
Missing sameAs links trigger advisory recommendations
Probing enforces strict 5-second timeout and 512KB payload limits

evals.prompt: Verify whether third-party authority nodes (Wikidata, LinkedIn, Wikipedia) validate the canonical brand identity on https://example.com.
evals.expected_output: Validation status of external knowledge graph identity anchors.
assertions: HTTP 200 response on Wikidata/LinkedIn substantiates identity
